newsitem.title: FINLAND: STARCKJOHANN UPS STAKE IN PENOPE.
newsitem.headline: STARCKJOHANN UPS STAKE IN PENOPE.

text.p: Finnish wood machinery wholesaler Penope Oy said in a statement on Friday hardware retailer and wholesaler Starckjohann had raised its stake in it to 50.5 percent of shares from 45.9 percent.
Starckjohann's stake of votes rose to 58.0 percent from 49.0 percent, but Penope would continue its operations as an independent subsidiary of Starckjohann and remain listed on the OTC-list.
"Starckjohann does not plan to increase its ownership in the company," Penope said.
The change followed Starckjohann's purchase of 38,000 unlisted K-shares from managing director Jarmo Kivisto.
